[h3]Hello, guys![/h3]
Join us on February 5th 6:00 PM CET when our developer Julian from Stillalive will present the new Grand Casino Tycoon. Together with our producer Fabian, he will show you some gameplay while talking about our latest project. 

Do not forget that you can also play the Free Demo, which can be found on the Grand Casino Tycoon store page. 🤝 Support our upcoming project by adding it to Wishlist and talking about it on Discord: https://discord.gg/RJ38YSqf9S
